title: HtmlOl
responsibility: Renders the native ol element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlOl.attributes
inputs.description: Native ol attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlOl.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native ol element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlOl
outputs.description: The actual native ol element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
